pkgmetadata.longdescription: A QindaTK package manager for Portage with a local LLM: installed packages with USE flags and where each value comes from, the dependency graph, why every package is installed, orphans, and impact previews of any change. The assistant plans installs, USE and keyword changes, patches and ebuilds for software outside the repositories (packaged in the qinda-local overlay), verifies them with emerge --pretend, and applies approved plans through a polkit-authorised helper that snapshots /etc/portage first. The model unloads itself before builds.
